thread:
olivia: Kicking off deploy for service-embed v2. Plan is feature flag 'embed_v2' 0% -> 20% with an initial canary at 3% for 15m. Release notes: small perf win + quantization change. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. @deploy-bot please start canary and route 3% to canary instances. Any objections?

deploy-bot: Started canary run (id=canary-5255000000). Applied routing: embed_v2=3%. Logs: https://ci.internal/reports/canary/5255000000

olivia: command I'll use if we need manual toggle: `/ff toggle --flag embed_v2 --percent=0 --reason="rollback"`

kevin: quick note — last rollout we saw p95 jump until caches warmed. Can we pin model-version=3.1 for the initial cohort? saves a risky auto-upgrade.

anika: +1 to pin. Also recommend auto-hold if error_rate > 0.5% or p95 > 300ms for any 5m window. Rollback plan: immediate set to 0% then pin back to model-version=3.0.

raj: Proposed ramp cadence: 3% (15m) -> 20% (15m) -> 50% (30m) -> 100% (gradual). Auto-rollback triggers: errors > 0.5% OR p95 increase > 60ms over baseline.

sara: I'll spin up a short-lived dashboard and set SNS alerts. Quick query to check p95: `sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{le=0.95}[5m]))` — will add a simple alert rule to the canary group.

olivia: ack. starting canary now :rocket:

deploy-bot: Can confirm: embed_v2=3% applied. Next scheduled ramp at +15m to 20%. Monitoring group: canary-5255000000.

monitoring-bot: Canary metrics (t+10m): errors=0.12% (2.4k tokens), p95=210ms, qps stable. No alerts.

olivia: looks good, proceed to ramp to 20% when ready.

deploy-bot: Executing ramp step -> embed_v2=20%. Command: `/ff set embed_v2 20 --by=deploy-bot --note="step2"`

monitoring-bot: Canary metrics (t+28m): errors=0.82%, p95=340ms, increased error volume from request routing service. Alert: canary-error-rate above 0.5% for 5m.

olivia: pausing rollout. rollback to last safe state (3%). @kevin you have the rollback steps?

kevin: initiating rollback: `/ff set embed_v2 3 --note="rollback-on-alert"` then pin model-version=3.0 for cohort1: `/model pin service-embed model=3.0 cohort=canary-5255000000`

deploy-bot: Applied embed_v2=3%. Pin command queued.

monitoring-bot: Post-rollback metrics (t+33m): errors=0.15%, p95=215ms.

olivia: thanks — creating an incident for root cause and will capture timelines. We'll hold full ramp until SRE+ML confirm model/quantization interactions.

anika: agree. For the postmortem, please include the exact config diff used for quantization and kernel selection.

sara: dashboard snapshot saved: https://dashboards.internal/snapshots/5255000000-canary

olivia: closing this thread for deploy ops — no further ramp until we triage. Great work catching it early :thumbsup:
